workloads.description: Run the canonical research-to-feature-push journey over two projects plus Kanbei.
No input after warmup; measure idle wakeups, RSS, CPU, and token spend.
Admit a bounded fan-out of agent loops and measure queueing, concurrency, and ceilings.
Apply a memory-v1 batch and measure catch-up, coverage lag, and suspect reads.
Inject an external commit that conflicts with a speculative branch.
Run an online snapshot, CAS copy with GC paused, restore, and derived rebuild.
